title: Nonexpansive fixed points in reflexive Banach spaces
exact_target: For every real reflexive Banach space X, every nonempty norm-closed bounded convex C subset X, and every nonexpansive map $F:C->C$, must F have a fixed point?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
